newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lernout & Hauspie to list on Easdaq.
newsitem.headline: Lernout & Hauspie to list on Easdaq.

text.p: Belgian, Nasdaq-listed speech technology firm Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products NV said on Wednesday it planned to seek a secondary listing for its shares on Europe's Easdaq small cap market in June.
No new shares will be issued through the listing, L&H said.

L&H said the move was designed to strengthen its shareholder base. "The listing on Brussels-based Easdaq...is the first significant step to introducing L&H to European investors. The listing should further enhance both liquidity and L&H's commercial profile in Europe," the company said.
